syncTitle: Sync your FilamentHub presets with OrcaSlicer
recoverTitle: Find and recover local OrcaSlicer materials, printer configurations, and print profiles
connectMessage: Please wait while the catalog is loaded.
unavailableMessage: The service may be undergoing maintenance. Your local OrcaSlicer presets are safe. Please try again later.
oauthTitle: Finish signing in in your web browser
oauthHint: Your browser should have opened. If it did not, copy this link and open it in your browser, then return here.
bambuHint: Enable Developer Mode only when the printer model or firmware requires it, then enter the local connection details.
bambuSerialHint: The plugin can usually discover it from MQTT
bambuSaved: The Bambu LAN connection was saved locally. Telemetry will appear after the printer responds.
bambuRemoved: The local Bambu connection was removed.
bambuInvalid: The Bambu connection was not saved. Check the local address, access code and printer modes.
bambuPairingFailed: The local printer responded, but FilamentHub pairing failed. Open the setup again and retry.
bambuRemoveFailed: Could not disconnect the printer on FilamentHub. Local settings were kept — please try again.
bambuLocalOnly: The address, serial number and access code stay in the plugin. Over LAN it reads the current print state and available print file, then sends job data and the consumption estimate to FilamentHub. No Bambu Cloud account is needed.
recoveryPartial: Recovered {count} of {total}. Try the rest again.
recoveryFailed: Could not recover the selected items. Please try again.
sessionExpired: Your FilamentHub session expired. Sign in again in the window.
printerBundleFailed: Could not download the printer profile set (HTTP {status}).
printerBundleInvalid: The printer profile set is invalid or could not be installed.
printerBundleInstalled: Installed printer profiles: {machines}; print profiles: {processes}. Restart OrcaSlicer to use them.
printerBundleLive: Installed printer profiles: {machines}; print profiles: {processes}. They are ready to use.
syncSignIn: Sign in to FilamentHub in the window, then sync.
syncUnreachable: Could not reach FilamentHub. Please try again later.
summaryListFailed: could not load your preset list from FilamentHub
summaryConflict: changed in both OrcaSlicer and FilamentHub — left as is: {count}
summaryUnsentDisabled: changed in OrcaSlicer, but sending is off in sync settings: {count}
summaryScanIncomplete: some profiles were skipped: base profile not found or duplicate name
summaryReportFailed: FilamentHub did not receive which presets are already in OrcaSlicer — sync again later
dropdownCurrent: The filament dropdown is up to date.
dropdownRestart: Restart OrcaSlicer to apply the changes in the filament dropdown.
bambuSearching: Looking for printers on this network…
bambuFound: Choose your printer and enter its LAN access code. Its feeding system will be read after connection.
bambuNotFound: No printer was found during this search. You can try again or enter its address below. Existing printer settings are kept.
bambuSearchIncomplete: The network search could not finish. You can try again or use a saved or manually entered address.
bambuSetupTimeout: No response yet. Your printer settings are kept. You can close this window and check the connection, or try again.
bambuSerialRequired: The printer replied without a serial number. Check that LAN Only Mode and Developer Mode are enabled on the printer, then try again.
bambuSetupUnavailable: The printer setup worker is unavailable. Close this window and open setup again.
localPermissionRetryFailed: The local connection is still blocked. No printer or account data was changed.
settingsServerNote: Both addresses lead to the same FilamentHub account. After switching you may need to sign in again.
settingsServerRestart: Restart OrcaSlicer to switch the server.
settingsAutoSyncHint: After sign-in and when your library changes on FilamentHub. When off, presets sync only when you press Sync.
settingsSuccessNoticeHint: When off, a notice appears only if something needs your attention.
settingsDeveloperModeHint: Shows the Report a problem button, which attaches the plugin log to your report.
settingsAccountHint: Which presets to sync is set in your profile on FilamentHub.
sliceSettingsPurpose: Keep exported G-code available in FilamentHub for print-cost calculations.
sliceSettingsLocal: When enabled, the plugin reads the G-code produced by OrcaSlicer, adds comments identifying FilamentHub profiles, and keeps a limited local copy. Print moves are not changed.
sliceSettingsRemote: The selected FilamentHub server receives the file name, printer model, printer and print profile names and identifiers, slicer version, export destination type, and identifiers linking this slice to this computer. The full G-code is uploaded only when you request a calculation.
sliceSettingsPermission: Reports are queued locally and sent by the signed-in FilamentHub page. Activation and slicing do not make this HTTP request, so this endpoint does not open a native permission dialog. Failed deliveries stay queued and are retried when the page is available.
sliceSettingsEnable: Save sliced files and send their details to FilamentHub
sliceReportingDisabled: Slice reporting is off. Open this slicing plugin’s settings to read what it does and enable it.
sliceQueued: Saved {name} locally. Its details will be sent when the FilamentHub page is signed in.
